> `it('the subject really carries a member-shaped row inside a block comment — read off the UNPROJECTED text')`

⇒ a fixture that silently lost its forcing row would leave the new pin green — **the new guard would become the inert guard it exists to cure.** That is this card's own thesis applied one level down, unprompted.
